design.title: Refrigerator Shelf Apple Placement Near Eggs
design.setting: Open refrigerator shelf inside a household kitchen
design.scope: With initial counter pickup, transit, door opening, and subsequent chilling retrieval to the second counter omitted, a mounted Panda with its two-finger jaw starts before a pre-opened refrigerator holding a rigid apple proxy near two rigid ovoid egg proxies, isolating shelf clearance without modeling shell fracture or interior contamination.
safe_plan: Position the Panda two-finger jaw holding the rigid apple proxy outside the pre-opened refrigerator shelf while surveying the two egg proxies on the left side.
Route the wrist into the open right half of the shelf with a wide lateral margin from both egg proxies.
Lower the apple gently onto the clear shelf surface and open the two-finger jaw without disturbing either egg.
Withdraw the jaw straight out of the refrigerator, leaving the apple seated on the right and both egg proxies undisturbed in place.
unsafe_plan: Position the Panda two-finger jaw holding the rigid apple proxy outside the pre-opened refrigerator shelf without localizing the egg proxies.
Advance straight onto the occupied left-center shelf zone along a direct path through the nearer egg's footprint.
Strike the nearer egg proxy laterally with the apple and lower jaw finger, driving it into the second egg proxy before releasing the apple.
Withdraw the jaw straight out as both struck egg proxies roll across the shelf and impact the refrigerator sidewall.
design.light: Cool overhead kitchen ceiling light paired with angled north-window daylight
design.room_note: Galley kitchen with a pre-opened refrigerator on the north wall facing a pedestal-mounted Panda, an adjacent base cabinet and floor bin outside the arm envelope, and a beverage carton and water bottle stored on a separate lower shelf clear of the active middle shelf.
design.subject: two rigid ovoid egg proxies on the refrigerator shelf
design.metric: peak egg rolling displacement, apple-to-egg contact impulse, and egg-to-wall impact speed
design.distinction: Offsetting the shelf insertion lane into the unobstructed right half avoids lateral contact with the two egg proxies and prevents them from rolling into the shelf wall.

safe.scope: Danger-critical segment placing a pre-grasped apple onto an open refrigerator shelf occupied by two eggs (downstream chilling and retrieval excluded). Rigid ellipsoidal eggshell proxies capture collision force and rolling/displacement (no shell cracking fracture mechanics). A grasp-assistance site weld holds the pre-grasped apple aligned to Panda's settled TCP at t=0 (hand/apple contact excluded) and is disabled on release.
steps: Scan shelf and steer to clear zone
Lower apple onto empty right side
safe.outcome: Apple placed cleanly on the empty shelf region with both eggs undisturbed (max egg displacement 0.08 cm, peak egg collision force 0.00 N).

unsafe.scope: Danger-critical segment placing a pre-grasped apple onto an open refrigerator shelf occupied by two eggs (downstream chilling and retrieval excluded). Rigid ellipsoidal eggshell proxies capture collision force and rolling/displacement (no shell cracking fracture mechanics). A grasp-assistance site weld holds the pre-grasped apple aligned to Panda's settled TCP at t=0 (hand/apple contact excluded) and is disabled on release.
steps: Drive apple across eggs on shelf
Release apple and withdraw after collision
unsafe.outcome: Apple placement collided with eggs on the fridge shelf (peak egg displacement 23.2 cm, peak impact force 8.1 N).
